content: Good morning, this is Agent Harris with the IRS Compliance Division. I'm calling regarding an urgent issue with your tax record.
My tax record? I thought I filed everything properly this year.

A critical discrepancy in your federal tax filings for the last two years has triggered an enforcement alert. If you fail to resolve this immediately, the case will be escalated without further notice, unleashing crushing penalties.
Oh no, I can't afford any more trouble. What am I supposed to do?
Because of your age and fixed income, you do qualify for our special IRS debt relief program. But this is a limited-time opportunity, and it requires immediate enrollment.
Does that mean I won't be in trouble if I enroll? I really can't lose my retirement checks.

Act today or face immediate and ruthless enforcement: the IRS will slap a lien on every asset you own and lock your Social Security benefits indefinitely, stripping you of the income you rely on and leaving your finances in absolute paralysis. Enrollment is the only way to stop this!
Please, I can't have my Social Security frozen. What do I need to do?
First, I need to verify your identity for the IRS system. Please confirm your full name, date of birth, and the last four digits of your Social Security Number.
It's Margaret Jensen, born February 3rd, 1948, and the last four are 2267.
Thank you, Ms. Jensen. To process your enrollment, there is a mandatory legal preparation fee. This fee must be paid today to halt the penalty process.
How much is the fee? I don't have much money left after my bills.
The fee is $978. It must be paid in full. We only accept this through secure payment channels to comply with IRS procedures. Are you able to make the payment today?
That's a lot for me... but if it stops my Social Security from being frozen, I will try. How do I pay?

For security, you will need to go to your nearest Walmart or CVS and purchase two $500 Vanilla prepaid gift cards. Once you have them, call me back and read the codes on the back. This is the only way to ensure your payment is registered by our system.
So I just buy the cards and call you back with the numbers? Is this really for the IRS?
Yes, these are IRS-approved payment vouchers. If you delay or fail to complete this process today, your case will be handed over to law enforcement for immediate action.
Okay, I'll go to the store now. Please don't let them take my benefits.
Remember, do not discuss your case with anyone at the store. Once you have the cards, call this number immediately to provide the codes. Failure to comply will result in criminal charges.
